title:
Deaf storytellers
should lead.
body: Stories to watch. Signs to learn.
caption: A home for South African Sign Language stories, shared with care.

title:
Learning starts
with people.
body:
SASL learning material is scarce.
Stories need clear credit and consent.
caption: The project addresses access to SASL stories and control over how they are shared.

title:
Learn SASL
through stories.
body:
Deaf storytellers share short stories.
Learners watch, read captions and explore signs.
caption: Deaf-Talks · working product name: SignStories · deaf-talks.vercel.app

title:
Storyteller.
Learner. Teacher.
body:
Storytellers share. Learners explore.
Teacher accounts are assigned manually.
caption: Sign-up offers Learner and Storyteller. Teacher promotion is managed by the team.

title: Choose your role.
body:
The recording selects Storyteller.
Demo credentials are concealed.
caption: Real screen recording · demo account · credentials redacted

title:
Start with
a private draft.
body:
Add a title and English caption.
Keep the story under 60 seconds and 50 MiB.
caption: MP4, WebM or MOV · the upload begins privately
credit: Upload account: Tino · credit shown in app: Tino

title:
Meaning stays
visible.
body:
The storyteller writes the English caption.
It stays with the story during playback.
caption: Visible caption: “Hello, how are you. I respect you and I support you.”
credit: Demo upload by Tino · credit: Tino

title:
A clear upload
progress bar.
body:
The file uploads directly to private storage.
Progress is visible while the page stays open.
caption: The selected demo video is 25.4 MB; progress reaches 100%.
credit: Demo upload by Tino · credit: Tino

title: Saved privately.
body:
Only the owner can view this draft.
Uploading is separate from publishing.
caption: The recording confirms: “Your story is saved as a private draft. Only you can view it.”
credit: Demo upload by Tino · credit: Tino

title:
Tag 3–5
key signs.
body:
Each tag has a label, meaning and timestamp.
Learners can return to that moment.
caption: Tagging is implemented in the repo; this step is explained because it was not recorded.
extra: REPO-VERIFIED EXPLANATION · NOT A RECORDED INTERACTION

title:
Consent.
Usage. Credit.
body:
Set the permitted use and credit line.
Confirm consent before publishing.
caption: Publication requires consent, nonprivate usage, a caption, credit and 3–5 valid signs.
extra: REPO-VERIFIED EXPLANATION · NOT A RECORDED INTERACTION

title:
A learner
signs in.
body:
The account view confirms the Learner role.
Browse stories starts the viewing flow.
caption: Login entry is omitted to keep account details private.

title: Choose a story.
body:
Published stories show the title, caption
and storyteller credit.
caption: Real demo account footage · published stories at /stories
credit:
Visible demo story: Tindo · credit: Tindo
Other demo card: Kakashi · credit: Kakashi

title:
Watch with
English captions.
body:
“Hello, my name is T I N O T E N D A, I am
learning sign language. It’s nice to meet you.”
caption: Story caption copied from the app; no new translation of the signing has been added.

Storyteller: gohan · credit: Tinothecreator
Demo story: Learning sign language

title: Find a moment.
body:
My name · 0:02
Learning · 0:12
Nice to meet you · 0:18
caption: Recorded sign list; the final frame is held for reading. Practice is a roadmap feature.

title:
Tap a sign.
Return to its time.
body:
The player seeks to the tag’s timestamp
and starts playback.
caption: Timestamp navigation is verified in the repo; a completed seek is not shown in this recording.
extra: REPO-VERIFIED EXPLANATION · NOT A RECORDED INTERACTION

title:
A manually
assigned role.
body:
The demo account is identified as Teacher.
All signed-in roles can browse stories.
caption: Teacher account view is held for reading. Review submission is excluded from this walkthrough.

title:
Stories across
roles.
body:
The teacher account returns to Home
and sees the latest stories.
caption: Today’s walkthrough shows account access and browsing. Human feedback is listed under what’s next.
credit:
Demo story: Tindo · credit: Tindo
Other demo card: Kakashi · credit: Kakashi

title:
Credit stays
with the story.
body:
Storyteller name + credit line + usage terms.
Withdraw to return a story to draft and private.
caption: Withdrawal hides the story from others and prevents new playback links.
extra: OWNERSHIP CONTROLS · VERIFIED IN THE REPO

title:
Permission
before playback.
body:
Row-level security checks consent and usage.
Private files use five-minute playback links.
caption: An already issued link may work until expiry. No download button; playback cannot prevent copying.
extra: PRIVATE STORAGE · SHORT-LIVED ACCESS · NO DOWNLOAD ACTION

title:
Next.js.
Supabase. Vercel.
body:
TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
Built with Codex for the OpenAI × Andela hackathon.
caption: Text-only AI belongs in the roadmap. People judge signing.

chapter: WHAT’S NEXT · NOT LIVE IN THIS DEMO
title:
Practice. Feedback.
AI-assisted captions.
body:
Practice recordings and human teacher feedback.
Text-only AI drafts with storyteller approval.
caption: No AI recognition, generation, grading or translation of sign language from video.
